queries: Give one repeat task a dress rehearsal
predecessorSearch.preserveAndImprove: Preserve the rehearsal-scoped disconnection, explicit source disposition, full work/home referents, human boundary and hard stop; replace undefined unknown/clean qualifiers, name the skill as the non-answering actor and stay at or below 148 words.

examplePair.workplaceExample: A communications lead checks a skill's source and requested access, then tests fictional meeting notes against an action-list criterion: action, owner, date and unresolved decision.
examplePair.nonWorkExample: A traveller checks a packing skill's source and requested access, then tests an invented weekend against a privacy criterion: use the supplied brief without asking for real bookings or email.
examplePair.sharedMechanism: In both settings the person checks provenance and requested access before testing, states what a useful result must contain, reruns failed cases after repair and keeps the final decision and consequence.
examplePair.surfaceAdaptation: The compact Paige card includes both short cases; Basics P8 owns the concept and the specified Build the Skill. Keep the Job. lab owns full practice.

readerContract.humanQuestion: I found a downloadable AI skill that promises to do a whole job for me. How can I tell whether it is useful and safe?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: The reader sees why a reusable skill can save repeated prompting and leaves with one small, realistic test before trusting it with real information or authority.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: She understands prompts but may treat a skill's title or popularity as proof that its procedure and code are trustworthy.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: A reusable skill is a procedure bundle and tool drawer, not an employee: it can preserve a workflow, but a person still owns access, testing, judgement and consequences.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: The same audit matters for a work action-list skill and a personal travel or household workflow whenever files, scripts, accounts or private data are involved.
readerContract.surfaceJob: One current, bounded, source-backed AI action that fits a compact Daily newspaper service card and routes to deeper learning.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I can try this without handing over the office keys or being frightened away from a useful tool.

canonicalTruth.freshnessTrigger: Anthropic changes skill structure, activation, availability, security guidance or cross-surface behavior.
The reader job, discovery claim, canonical destination or no-Promptoscope ruling changes.

strengthsToUse: Answer with the useful distinction immediately.
Separate what the source establishes from the action LAiDIES recommends.
patternsNotToCopy: Do not copy the legal-news structure.
Do not reuse its label analogy.
Do not inherit its claim scope or dates.

glossaryAccumulation.producerGuard: Define the skill through the action, not a vocabulary list.
glossaryAccumulation.preventionEvidence: The card gives one mechanism and one test.

templateRepetition.producerGuard: Let the reader's trust decision determine the order.
templateRepetition.preventionEvidence: The card moves promise to mechanism to dress rehearsal.

decorativeAnalogy.producerGuard: Use the keys line only to name access and authority.
decorativeAnalogy.preventionEvidence: The action immediately specifies files, access and test cases.

referenceConfetti.preventionEvidence: Voice comes from the precise dress-rehearsal line.

missingMechanism.producerGuard: Say why reuse helps and how the description-to-match-to-load sequence works.
missingMechanism.preventionEvidence: The opening connects repeated prompting to a description that tells the AI when to load instructions, files and executable code.

genericAction.producerGuard: Name an action a non-technical reader can actually perform and a disposition after failure.
genericAction.preventionEvidence: The reader checks requested access, declines what the task cannot justify, tests against exact criteria, then repairs and reruns or leaves the skill in rehearsal.

jargonBeforeMeaning.producerGuard: Explain reusable workflow before product terminology.
jargonBeforeMeaning.preventionEvidence: The opening says what the bundle saves and does.

disconnectedSystem.producerGuard: Connect procedure, code, access, test and human decision.
disconnectedSystem.preventionEvidence: Every component changes the go/no-go decision.

joylessInstruction.producerGuard: Make the safety move feel doable.
joylessInstruction.preventionEvidence: One dress rehearsal replaces a compliance lecture.

purposeTooNarrow.preventionEvidence: The deeper class owns building and maintenance.

mechanismBeforeMotivation.producerGuard: Lead with the repeated-prompt problem the feature solves.
mechanismBeforeMotivation.preventionEvidence: The first clause begins with rebuilding the same prompt every week before defining the skill.

workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.producerGuard: Keep the example to one phrase.
workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.preventionEvidence: The procedure remains the card's subject.

technicalExplainerVoice.preventionEvidence: No API, filesystem or progressive-disclosure terminology reaches the card.

falseBreakingUrgency.producerGuard: Present a practical tip, not news urgency.

missingNewcomerBackground.producerGuard: Explain a skill before advising on one.
missingNewcomerBackground.preventionEvidence: The first sentence names its reusable parts and job.

technicalReaderAssumption.producerGuard: Translate audit into read, check and test.

implausibleAudienceAction.producerGuard: Do not ask the reader to configure controls she may not have or perform a professional security audit.
implausibleAudienceAction.preventionEvidence: The reader checks visible existing connections, disconnects unneeded ones, and declines to run where access cannot be seen or changed.

laidiesVoiceAbsent.producerGuard: Keep it adult, warm, specific and lightly sharp—not a vendor checklist.
laidiesVoiceAbsent.preventionEvidence: The card begins with a familiar weekly frustration, uses concrete work and home details, and keeps the exact dress-rehearsal landing.

internalScaffoldingExposedToReader.producerGuard: No gate, claim-ID or HOLD language in the card.
internalScaffoldingExposedToReader.preventionEvidence: Only the usable reader action appears.

newspaperHierarchyUnclear.producerGuard: One headline and one compact action block.
newspaperHierarchyUnclear.preventionEvidence: The card has no desk scaffolding.

sourceAvailabilityMistakenForEditorialVa.producerGuard: Publish only because the reader faces a real skill-trust decision.
sourceAvailabilityMistakenForEditorialVa.preventionEvidence: The discovery reel is excluded as evidence.

missingAidbRelevanceCheck.producerGuard: Search recent AIDB coverage and record a dated absence when none exists.
missingAidbRelevanceCheck.preventionEvidence: The August 11 repository search found no relevant AIDB Agent Skills analysis.

predeterminedThesisInsteadOfInvestigatio.producerGuard: Test the skill promise against official mechanism and risks.
predeterminedThesisInsteadOfInvestigatio.preventionEvidence: Useful reuse and unsafe trust remain separate findings.

weakReaderPremise.producerGuard: Address the actual viral skill-pack decision.
weakReaderPremise.preventionEvidence: The reader asks whether a downloadable whole-job promise is safe and useful.

adviceBelowReaderBaseline.preventionEvidence: The reader distinguishes provenance from proof, audits requested access before testing, states two acceptance criteria and knows what to do after a failed case.

promptAdviceMistakenForEnforcement.producerGuard: Do not present better wording as a security control.
promptAdviceMistakenForEnforcement.preventionEvidence: Access limits and behavior tests do the safety work.

longRunningWorkflowRealityIgnored.producerGuard: Require a stop decision before real use.
longRunningWorkflowRealityIgnored.preventionEvidence: The exact landing says that a workflow the reader cannot inspect, limit, judge and stop gets no real work.

genericEditorialVoice.producerGuard: Make every example do the reader's real trust-decision work.
genericEditorialVoice.preventionEvidence: The candidate is 147 words by repository word count and uses full compact sentences with one warm colleague contrast.

fictionalInputMistakenForIsolation.producerGuard: Never treat fictional, synthetic or non-sensitive input as containment for an executable AI extension; establish trusted provenance and inspect requested access before any behavior test.
fictionalInputMistakenForIsolation.preventionEvidence: A clean workspace and disconnection of every live account or folder are required for rehearsal even when the real job later needs them.

unbuiltDestinationPresentedAsLive.producerGuard: Offer only exact publicly available destinations as current reader actions; label planned or held learning as future and do not imply a live route.
unbuiltDestinationPresentedAsLive.preventionEvidence: No reader-facing learning destination appears until exact public route truth is separately proved.

repairScopeSubstitutedForSpecifiedScope.producerGuard: Retain the exact scope that makes a control effective or forward-test any substitution against the original failure scenario.
repairScopeSubstitutedForSpecifiedScope.preventionEvidence: The card disconnects every live account or folder for the rehearsal, explicitly including ones the real job later needs; the expense transfer can no longer retain its live system.

compressionDropsReferent.producerGuard: After cutting, preserve the actor, object, action and criterion so a cold reader can name what is tested and what passes.
compressionDropsReferent.preventionEvidence: The work context carries the reusable skill; the home case explicitly names packing skill, invented brief and list.

safetyQualifierWithUndefinedBoundary.producerGuard: Replace safety adjectives with observable conditions and an exact disposition; popularity, familiarity and branding do not prove a source is vetted.
safetyQualifierWithUndefinedBoundary.preventionEvidence: The source rule uses can vet plus however popular, and the access rule names live accounts/folders plus a cannot-see-or-change stop.

compoundModifierInvertsAgent.producerGuard: Name the actor whose behavior is tested; reject any compressed modifier that could attach the behavior to sensitive input instead.
compoundModifierInvertsAgent.preventionEvidence: The behavior test says one it should not answer, where it unambiguously refers to the immediately active skill.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: A reusable skill can save a repeated procedure, but its executable bundle can inherit live access; the rehearsal therefore needs a clean workspace before fictional examples prove anything.
causalSequence: A description tells the AI when to load instructions, files and runnable code.
Before rehearsal, the person inspects maker and contents and disconnects every live account or folder, including access the real job later needs.
Work and home tests name both output and pass criterion; normal, awkward and should-stay-quiet requests test behavior.
A failed case is repaired and rerun; any skill that cannot be inspected, limited, judged and stopped gets no real work.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: Fictional notes must produce an action list naming action, owner, date and open decision.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A packing skill given an invented brief must produce a list fitting weather and plans without real bookings or email.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Begin self-made; require the same inspection for colleague/company skills; exclude unknown downloads unless fully audited; isolate the rehearsal; test and stop.

analogyPlan.concept: A reusable procedure is not accountable staff.
analogyPlan.analogy: Dress rehearsal before handing over the keys.
analogyPlan.mapping: The rehearsal is behavior testing in a workspace disconnected from live accounts and folders; the keys are existing access and authority.
analogyPlan.limit: A skill is software and instructions, not a person rehearsing a role.
analogyPlan.whyItHelps: It makes isolation, testing and the hard stop one memorable decision.

humourPlan.lessonJob: Convenient, not a colleague keeps the human boundary warm and concise.

draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: 147-word Paige card: motivation/trigger, human boundary, rehearsal-scoped access, source disposition, paired criteria, unambiguous behavior tests and hard stop.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: No label-colon fragments or generic tips list; the prose follows one dress rehearsal from setup to go/no-go.

communicationDesign.surfaceAdaptation: Answer first, make the hidden bundle and access concrete, then land one safe first-use test.

humanQuestion.plannedEvidence: The headline and first line frame that choice.

usefulCuriosity.plannedEvidence: The card reveals what to inspect.

invisibleProcessConcrete.plannedEvidence: Instructions, scripts, references and matching task are named plainly.

familiarTechnicalMovement.plannedEvidence: Fictional meeting notes supply the bounded case.

limitationsConsequences.reason: The workflow can be useful and unsafe at once.
limitationsConsequences.plannedEvidence: The stop condition is inability to judge or halt it.

humourSurprise.reason: The keys line makes authority memorable.
humourSurprise.plannedEvidence: It is immediately mapped to access and real work.

betterNextQuestion.plannedEvidence: The replacement question is whether the reader can inspect, test, judge and stop it.

explanationArc.adaptation: A service card compresses the arc into one usable move and routes depth to the class.

explanationReasoningDesign.humanEntry: A viral skill pack promises a ready-made department, and the reader wants the useful shortcut without importing hidden risk.
explanationReasoningDesign.fakeUnderstandingRisk: She may think a professional label or download count proves the procedure is competent and safe.
firstPrinciplesSequence: A skill loads reusable content when a task matches.
That content and the surrounding environment shape what it can do or expose.
Source selection and access limits must come before execution; controlled examples then test whether the result can be judged and stopped before real use.
explanationReasoningDesign.explainBackTest: Explain why a skill that produces a good fictional action list still has not earned access to real confidential meeting notes.
explanationReasoningDesign.transferCase: Apply the same rule to a personal packing skill that asks to read booking confirmations.
explanationReasoningDesign.usefulLanding: If you cannot inspect it, limit it, test it, judge it and stop it, do not give it real work yet.
explanationReasoningDesign.rewindEraAdaptation: The dress rehearsal and keys image performs the testing-and-authority job; no decorative celebrity reference is used.

evidenceAnalysis.claimUnderInspection: A downloadable AI skill can safely replace a marketing, finance, design or legal department.
evidenceAnalysis.primaryEvidence: Anthropic Agent Skills documentation checked August 11, 2026.
evidenceAnalysis.establishes: Skills can package reusable instructions, scripts and resources and load them when relevant.
evidenceAnalysis.doesNotEstablish: Professional competence, accountability, safety, current dependencies or correctness of any third-party pack.
evidenceAnalysis.claimedImpact: The reader can install a ready-made department.
evidenceAnalysis.realConsequence: The reader begins with a self-made or product-maker skill and may reuse one bounded procedure only after inspecting its contents, limiting its environment and testing behavior; fictional input alone is not a sandbox.
evidenceAnalysis.aidbReason: A repository search of recent AIDB records on August 11 found no relevant Agent Skills analysis; official Anthropic documentation supplies the product truth and the absence does not create a publication claim.

representativeProofPlan.highestRisk: A vague safety qualifier or compressed modifier causing a viral pack or confidential request to bypass the stop rule.
representativeProofPlan.plannedProof: Test a popular named-creator download and confirm cannot vet keeps it out; test the final behavior sentence and confirm the skill, not the request, is the non-answering actor; rerun the live-expense transfer.
representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: A cold reader excludes a popular but unvetted pack, disconnects live expense access for rehearsal and chooses a harmless request the skill should not answer.
